Measured Fe-bearing non-stoichiometric sample, not an ideal endmember. Conventional hexagonal axes of trigonal R-3m, six O per cell, Z=1 on the empirical O6 basis. Cell parameters are observed ambient values; fitted V0 is separate. Position-only fallback: no sample-specific atomic occupancies or hydrogen coordinates are asserted. Peak intensities of 1 are display markers only. No anisotropic high-pressure lattice evolution is supplied; volume-only scaling is an approximation.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Single-crystal hydrostatic compression of the measured Fe-bearing phase E sample; quartz experimental pressure scale.
- **V0:** p. 563, Results: 105.627(7) conventional hexagonal-cell angstrom^3, freely refined; not the ambient Table 1 observation 105.633(16).
- **K0:** p. 563: isothermal KT=92.9(7) GPa, freely refined.
- **K0 prime:** p. 563: 7.3(2), freely refined; not fixed to 4.
- **Equation:** Third-order Birch–Murnaghan with f=((V0/V)^(2/3)-1)/2, F=P/\[3 f (1+2 f)^(5/2)\] and F=K0\[1+1.5(Kprime-4)f\]; p. 563 F–f discussion.
- **Errors:** Parenthetical reported errors retained; confidence level and fitted covariance matrix are not supplied.
- **Range:** Table 1 exact extrema; room temperature reported qualitatively.
- **Fit objective:** Author thesis (2000), Section 2.11, Eq. 2.31, p. 45: pressure-residual weighted least squares, chi\_w\_squared divided by n-m; pressure and propagated volume esds combined. Exact numerical implementation unresolved.

</details>
